facts.fact: Madagascar's cybercrime bill no. 042/2026 of 7 July 2026, 96 articles, is back on the National Assembly agenda with committee examination set for 2 November 2026, after its examination was postponed at the September extraordinary session.
facts.system: Projet de loi n 042/2026 sur la lutte contre la cybercriminalite

facts.fact: The bill is meant to update Madagascar's existing 2014 law on cybercrime, which the report treats as the current legislation.

note: No arrest, prosecution or published figures stated.
